```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year = 2020,
  state = "TX",
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c(
    total = "B15003_001",
    bachelors = "B15003_022",
    masters = "B15003_023",
    professional = "B15003_024",
    doctorate = "B15003_025"
  ),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(
    median_age = "B01002_001",
    population = "B01003_001"
  ),
  year = 2020,
  state = "CA",
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
age_ca |>
  select(GEOID, NAME, variable, estimate) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = variable, values_from = estimate) |>
  mutate(
    label = if_else(
      min_rank(desc(population)) <= 5,
      NAME,
      NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = population, y = median_age)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), check_overlap = TRUE, hjust = -0.1) +
  scale_x_log10(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Age and Population Across California Counties",
    x = "County population (log scale)",
    y = "Median age (years)",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  filter(variable %in% c("bachelors", "masters", "professional", "doctorate")) |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    percent_bachelors_or_higher = 100 * sum(estimate) / first(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(
    x = reorder(NAME, percent_bachelors_or_higher),
    y = percent_bachelors_or_higher
  )) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_percent(scale = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Adults with a Bachelor's Degree or Higher by State",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Percentage of adults",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: texas-income-map
income_tx |>
  filter(!is.na(estimate)) |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    fill = "Annual income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey (ACS) 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0)
  )
```
